title: OrcaTestConfig
description: JSON Schema for OrcaTestEngine configuration. Licensed under a dual MIT + GM license (see project LICENSE).

name.description: Optional human-readable name for this test configuration.

description.description: Optional longer description of the test scenario.

defaultSlowThresholdMillis.description: Global default threshold for slow-event detection in milliseconds. If null, slow-event warnings are disabled.

randomSeed.description: Seed for deterministic RNG used for RANDOM-mode event selection.

runMode.description: Global run mode for the engine. Currently the engine primarily uses RANDOM but SEQUENTIAL/MIXED are reserved for future expansion.

defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: Optional default timeout (seconds) for event scripts. Individual events may override this via timeoutSeconds.

events.description: The complete list of StressEvent definitions comprising the test plan.

targetPackage.description: Android package name of the app under test. Used by SystemInspector for process monitoring and logcat tagging.

debug.description: When true, OrcaEngine emits additional debug logging about selection, cooldowns, and triggers.

debugBreakAfterEvent.description: If true, Orca pauses after each event completes and prompts on the console.

debugBreakOnError.description: If true, Orca pauses whenever an event fails (non-zero exit code or failure policy) and prompts on the console.

debugBreakOnRetry.description: If true, Orca pauses whenever an event enters its retry loop.

debugBreakOnReboot.description: If true, Orca pauses when an event that causesReboot=true is about to enter reboot recovery.

debugBreakWhenPreconditionsFail.description: If true, Orca pauses whenever an event is skipped due to failing preconditions or requireState.

debugBreakBeforeEvent.description: If true, OrcaEngine enters interactive step mode and pauses before executing each selected event.

maxTestDurationSeconds.description: Optional global cap on test duration (seconds) when using runForDuration().

postRebootScript.description: Optional path to a script executed after reboot recovery completes (e.g., reapply settings or re-initialize tools).

LogcatConfig.description: Controls logcat capture behavior during a stress run.

enabled.description: If true, logcat capture is enabled during runs.

rotateOnReboot.description: If true, logcat capture is stopped before reboot and restarted after the device comes back online.

tag.description: Optional tag or substring used to filter logcat output (e.g., a package name).

StressEvent.description: Represents a single executable unit within a stress test: a script, NO-OP, SEQUENCE, or WAIT_FOR_DEVICE.

id.description: Unique logical ID for this event. Must be unique across all events.

stopOnFailure.description: If true, the engine stops immediately when this event fails.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the event.

type.description: High-level behavior of the event (script execution, sequence, no-op, or wait-for-device).

mode.description: Determines how/when the event is selected: RANDOM pool, SEQUENTIAL sequence-only, or CONDITIONAL triggers.

slowThresholdMillis.description: Per-event override for slow-event threshold in milliseconds. Uses config.defaultSlowThresholdMillis if null.

processDeathAllowed.description: If true, process death after this event is allowed and will not be treated as a failure.

tags.description: Arbitrary classification tags for this event (e.g., 'network', 'power', 'reboot').

causesReboot.description: If true, this event is expected to trigger a device reboot and will activate reboot recovery logic.

waitForBoot.description: If true and causesReboot is set, OrcaEngine waits for BOOT_COMPLETED after reboot.

restartAppAfterBoot.description: If true and causesReboot is set, OrcaEngine restarts the target app after reboot recovery.

weight.description: Base weight for RANDOM-mode selection. Higher values increase selection frequency relative to other events.

profileWeights.description: Optional run-profile-specific overrides for weight, e.g. { "aggressive": 5, "light": 1 }.

cooldownSeconds.description: Minimum number of seconds that must elapse between successful executions of this event.

maxExecutions.description: Maximum number of times this event may run in a single test. After that it will be skipped.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional script timeout for this event (seconds). Overrides config.defaultTimeoutSeconds.

durationSeconds.description: Optional target duration (seconds) for long-running or ramp tests.

safetyLevel.description: Relative safety classification: LOW, MODERATE, HIGH, or CRITICAL.

enabled.description: If false, the event is disabled and never runs.

language.description: Script language handler. Only meaningful when type == SCRIPT or a script is associated.

args.description: Optional argument list passed to the script handler.

env.description: Environment variables passed to the script execution.

requiresRoot.description: If true, the event requires that SystemInspector reports root access as available.

requireState.description: State key/value pairs that must be present for this event to be eligible.

setState.description: State key/value pairs applied after a successful event execution.

clearState.description: List of state keys to remove from the engine state immediately after this event succeeds.

onFailure.description: Controls how the engine reacts to failures: stop, log-only, retry, or disable future runs of this event.

postEvents.description: List of event IDs to automatically trigger after this event succeeds.

conditionalTriggers.description: Conditional rules that can trigger other events based on script output, exit code, or metrics.

sequence.description: For SEQUENCE-type events, the ordered list of child event IDs to execute.

logOutput.description: If true, stdout is logged when the event succeeds.

logErrors.description: If true, stderr is logged when the event fails.

logFile.description: Optional file path for event-specific logging.

debugBreak.description: If true, OrcaEngine pauses before executing this event (event-level breakpoint).

ScriptDefinition.description: Defines where the script content comes from: inline lines or an external file path. Exactly one must be provided.

inline.description: Inline script lines embedded directly in the configuration.

file.description: Path to an external script file.

Preconditions.description: System-level constraints that must be satisfied for an event to be eligible for execution.

batteryAbove.description: Event is only eligible if battery >= this percentage.

batteryBelow.description: Event is only eligible if battery <= this percentage.

networkRequired.description: If true, a network connection must be available.

deviceIdle.description: If true, the device must be in an idle state (as defined by SystemInspector).

screenOn.description: If true, the display must be on.

chargingRequired.description: If true, the device must be plugged in and charging.

rootRequired.description: If true, root access must be available.

fileMustExist.description: List of paths that must exist on the device for the event to run.

adbAvailable.description: If true, ADB connection must be available; if false, requires no ADB connection; if null, ADB state is not checked.

MetricsConfig.description: Controls which metrics are captured around the event execution.

captureCpuUsage.description: If true, SystemInspector attempts to collect CPU usage metrics.

captureMemoryUsage.description: If true, SystemInspector attempts to collect memory usage metrics.

captureBatteryLevel.description: If true, SystemInspector attempts to collect current battery level.

customMetrics.description: Optional list of custom metric identifiers that a SystemInspector may interpret.

RetryPolicy.description: Defines how the engine retries a failing event when FailurePolicy.RETRY is used.

strategy.description: Backoff strategy used to compute per-attempt delays.

ConditionalTrigger.description: Rule that can trigger another event based on script output, exit codes, or metrics.

triggerEventId.description: ID of the event to trigger when conditions are satisfied.

ifOutputContains.description: If non-null, trigger fires only if stdout or stderr contains this substring.

ifExitCodeNotZero.description: If true, trigger fires only when exitCode != 0.

ifExitCodeEquals.description: If non-null, trigger fires only when exitCode equals this value.

ifMetricAbove.description: Map of metricName → threshold. All metrics must be strictly greater than the threshold.

ifMetricBelow.description: Map of metricName → threshold. All metrics must be strictly less than the threshold.
